Marca · v1 · sep 2026

Lo que quieres saber, en punto.

Lucaku investigates what one person asked about and reads it back to them, every day, at the hour they chose. The identity is built on one object: el punto. It ends the name the way a finished answer ends a sentence, it is the whole of the app icon, and when Lucaku is speaking it is the thing that moves.

Wordmark

Drawn, not typeset. Six letters built from one set of rules, closed by the point.

Every stem top is sheared like a broad pen at a shallow angle. The l turns out on the baseline. Curves are drawn lighter than stems so the round letters don't look heavy.

Primary · text-primary, point in accent
Reversed · white on accent #1E647E
On white · ink #1C1C1E, point #1E647E
On black · #F2F2F2, point #74B9D1

The mark

The first and last characters of the name: l and the point. The same construction, drawn heavier so the tail and the point still separate at 16 px.

Use it where the wordmark can't fit. Never beside the wordmark: the wordmark already contains it.

App icon

Drawn on a 1024 grid. The field is the approved accent lit from above, two stops inside the accent's own hue. The glyph is 56% of the canvas height.

For iOS dark appearance the point turns #74B9D1 on black. Tinted appearance is plain white; iOS recolours it.

Colour roles

The approved palette, unchanged. What's new is a rule for where the accent goes: the accent marks the point. The point in the wordmark, the one primary action on a screen, the word being spoken right now. It is never decoration.

accent#1E647E · dark #74B9D1

The point, the primary action, the word being spoken.

accent-on#FFFFFF · dark #05262F

Text and glyphs on an accent fill only.

bg#F2F2F7 · dark #000000

The screen. Content sits on it or on surface, never on accent.

surface#FFFFFF · dark #1C1C1E

Grouped fields, the listening card. Separation by value, not by a border.

surface-2#FFFFFF · dark #262629

Something raised above a surface in dark mode (sheets, menus).

text-primary#1C1C1E · dark #F2F2F2

Wordmark letters, titles, body.

text-secondaryrgba(60,60,67,.68) · dark rgba(235,235,245,.64)

Context, metadata, field labels.

borderrgba(60,60,67,.29) · dark rgba(84,84,88,.6)

Hairline dividers inside a group. Not an outline around cards.

Type

San Francisco, the system face, at the HIG scale. There is no brand typeface. The only drawn letters are the wordmark's, and they are never used to set text.

Mostly Regular. One Semibold moment per screen. Left-aligned, sentence case.

The point speaks

Where another audio app would draw equaliser bars, Lucaku uses the point. It swells with the voice's loudness while Lucaku reads, and sits still when paused. The word being read takes the accent.

With Reduce Motion on, the point stays still and the text shows fully read.

Buenos días, Ana. Hoy tengo tres cosas sobre el café y una sobre Atlético Nacional.

Voice

Calm, direct, in the second person (tú), Colombian Spanish. It talks like a well-read friend who did the reading for you. It admits when there is nothing new.

One switch, at the bottom

Round two was rejected for two mode switches. Now there is a single text link below the actions. Sign up is the same screen with a Name row added to the group.

The screen shows the product

The founder said the app lacked something "live". The card previews what a morning sounds like, with the point speaking and the words lighting up as they're read. Nobody signing up for an audio product has heard it yet; this is the first taste.

Radii follow size

Grouped fields and the listening card are cards (16). Buttons are full capsules. Small controls use 8 or 10. No borders: surfaces separate from bg by value.

Accent appears once

Apart from the wordmark's point, only Entrar and the speaking word use the accent. Google keeps its own mark on a neutral surface, as Google's sign-in guidelines require.

What Lucaku is not

  • Not a music app. No equaliser bars, vinyl, headphones or play triangles as brand elements.
  • Not a news feed. No tickers, breaking-red, or endless lists. One summary a day, finished.
  • Not an "AI" brand. No sparkles, gradients or glowing orbs. The research is the product, not the model.
  • Not a podcast network. No show art, no hosts, no microphones.
  • Not loud. No emoji, no exclamation marks, no countdowns or streaks.
  • Not a font. The wordmark is never retyped in any typeface, including SF.
